name: RV Road
referenceNotes: Elevated interchange between the Green Line (opened 2017) and the Yellow Line (opened 2025) on Rashtriya Vidyalaya Road — the two lines' viaducts cross perpendicular to each other, with 4 platforms across 2 levels. Represents the ELEVATED + INTERCHANGE case. Structural facts are well-documented; entrance/material detail is sparse in public sources, so is left conservative.
